newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity signs engine JV in China.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity signs engine JV in China.

text.p: Anglo-U.S. engineering group LucasVarity Plc said on Wednesday that one of its divisions, VarityPerkins, had signed a joint venture deal with Tianjin Engine Works in China.
The initial investment in the joint venture will be close to 18 million stg, the company said in a statement.
LucasVarity said the venture, to be called Perkins Engines (Tianjin) Ltd, would manufacture more than 50,000 engines a year in Tianjin, China's third largest city, by 2001.
In long term the capacity will grow to 120,000 engines a year.
The engines will be the four-litre and six-litre Phaser and 1000 series, the widely sold engines in Perkins' stable.

This joint venture follows a licence agreement between VarityPerkins and TEW three years ago. Some leading Chinese truck, bus, and agro-equipment makers fit Perkins engines sold under the licence agreement.
LucasVarity said it expected the demand for diesel engines to double in China by the end of the decade.
